written_here: Everything in this directory is generated by generate.py in this repository; nothing is copied from an external source.

generator.dependencies: Python standard library only (base64, json, math, struct, zlib)
generator.deterministic: no clock, no randomness; a second run rewrites the same bytes

equivalence: The OBJ holds the glTF triangles rotated from glTF's Y-up to spec 3.1's Z-up ((x, y, z) -> (-z, -x, y), es_assets::gltf's AXIS_FIX) with vt = (u, 1 - v), since the OBJ reader flips v as MuJoCo's does; every coordinate is dyadic, so both routes give bit-identical triangles. The MJCF material's <layer> roles rgb / orm / normal / emissive and emission="2" are the glTF material's baseColorTexture / metallicRoughnessTexture / normalTexture / emissiveTexture and emissiveFactor 1 x KHR_materials_emissive_strength 2.
